label: ODNI publishes its report on possible links between the WIV and the origins of COVID-19
description: Baseline event for treating the origin of COVID as an officially disputed, unresolved matter.

label: The FTC imposes a record penalty and new privacy restrictions on Facebook
description: Key regulatory milestone showing that the Facebook/Cambridge Analytica data scandal had structural compliance and oversight consequences.

label: OpenAI announces Sam Altman’s departure and names Mira Murati interim CEO
description: Turning point in OpenAI’s governance crisis and a documentary anchor for the vector on political-corporate control of the lab.

label: DeepSeek presents the DeepSeek-V3 technical report on arXiv
description: Technical milestone useful for challenging exclusivity narratives by pointing to a competitor publicly claiming strong efficiency and performance.

label: The White House makes sustaining and enhancing U.S. global AI dominance official policy
description: Doctrinal event linking national security, competitiveness, and removal of regulatory barriers in U.S. AI policy.

label: The AI Action Plan RFI is published in the Federal Register
description: Administrative step that operationalizes the White House order and opens a formal channel of influence over U.S. AI strategy.

label: OpenAI publishes its proposals for the U.S. AI Action Plan
description: Direct corporate intervention in the policy debate over export controls, copyright, infrastructure, and state adoption of AI.

label: Facebook formally rebrands its parent company as Meta
description: Public launch of the metaverse-centered corporate narrative and the announced reporting split between Family of Apps and Reality Labs.

label: Meta keeps pairing metaverse rhetoric with a growing AI product story
description: Connect 2023 shows Meta still selling the metaverse while leaning harder on AI assistants, smart glasses, and engagement infrastructure amid a slower-than-expected transition.

label: Meta announces deeper cuts in its Year of Efficiency
description: Meta ties further layoffs, role closures, and organizational flattening to financial performance, a difficult environment, and continued AI investment.

label: The IRS issues Notice 2023-63 on Section 174 expenditures
description: Official tax-administration milestone showing that research-expense amortization was an active and documented policy condition during the tech correction.

label: The House passes H.R. 7024 with Section 174 relief language
description: Congressional attempt to restore immediate domestic R&D expensing, indicating the perceived weight of the Section 174 change.

label: Meta files its 2023 annual report with continued Reality Labs losses
description: SEC filing confirms the Family of Apps / Reality Labs split, continued loss expectations for Reality Labs, and parallel investment in AI and the metaverse.

label: OpenAI restores Altman and installs a new initial board
description: Institutional settlement of the November crisis, including a new board, Microsoft observer role, and formal governance-review promises.

label: OpenAI expands its board with new institutional figures
description: Post-crisis board expansion adds nonprofit, legal, and major-platform credentials to OpenAI's governance structure.

label: Ilya Sutskever leaves OpenAI
description: A core technical founder exits months after the governance crisis, reinforcing the link between board rupture and leadership reconfiguration.

label: OpenAI forms a board-level Safety and Security Committee
description: OpenAI links frontier-model training, safety oversight, and external security expertise in a formal board structure after the governance crisis.

label: OpenAI appoints Paul Nakasone to its board and safety committee
description: The board rebuild adds a former NSA and U.S. Cyber Command chief, strengthening the documented defense and security character of OpenAI's legitimacy network.

label: John Schulman leaves OpenAI for Anthropic
description: A co-founder departs for a direct rival and publicly frames the move around alignment, deepening the governance-and-talent pattern around OpenAI.

label: Musk's bid sharpens the legal fight over OpenAI's nonprofit mission
description: The public dispute over sale constraints and charitable purpose becomes a concrete pressure point in OpenAI's conversion path.

label: OpenAI completes its public benefit restructuring with regulators standing down
description: OpenAI formalizes a new legal and capital structure that combines nonprofit control claims, public-benefit form, and an updated Microsoft arrangement.

label: OpenAI's board rejects Elon Musk's bid for the nonprofit controller
description: Public dispute over mission, ownership, and conversion pathways at the institutional core of OpenAI.

label: Facebook's S-1 publicly documents Peter Thiel's board seat and early-investor role
description: The IPO filing records Thiel as a director since 2005, an early investor, and a board actor inside Facebook's concentrated governance structure.

label: Meta's proxy states that Peter Thiel will retire from the board after the annual meeting
description: The proxy shows the durability of Thiel's board role from 2005 into the Meta era and records his committee-level governance authority at the point of departure.

label: A large-scale COVID work-from-home study documents changed collaboration and communication patterns
description: Academic evidence that the pandemic's forced shift into remote work reorganized collaboration, focus time, and communication media for information workers.

label: Research highlights new surveillance and privacy risks in pandemic remote work
description: COVID-era remote work is documented as expanding security risks and adoption of workplace monitoring and surveillance technologies.

label: Cross-company research argues work from home became a normalized post-pandemic expectation
description: Evidence from 17 companies across 12 countries suggests pandemic work-from-home arrangements altered policy, flexibility, and the psychological contract of work.

label: The U.S. Copyright Office opens a formal inquiry into AI training and copyright
description: Federal Register notice launches official comment-gathering on copyrighted training inputs, disclosure, and the legal status of AI outputs.

label: The U.S. Copyright Office releases its pre-publication report on generative AI training
description: Official report formalizes the federal analysis of infringement, fair use, market harm, and licensing in the use of copyrighted works for AI training.

label: A scoping review documents social media as core pandemic communication infrastructure
description: Review evidence shows that COVID-era platform dependence extended beyond remote work into information consumption, mental-health discourse, public-attitude tracking, and infodemic management.

label: A federal ruling splits Anthropic's training defense from piracy-related exposure
description: AP reports that a judge treated AI training as potentially fair use while allowing a separate trial over allegations tied to pirated book acquisition.

label: Major publishers sue Meta over Llama training inputs
description: Large publishers and author Scott Turow file a class-action lawsuit alleging that Meta used millions of copyrighted books and journal articles to train Llama without permission or compensation; Meta denies wrongdoing and says it will fight the case.

label: A national study documents heavy youth screen exposure during the pandemic period
description: Analysis of 2020 to 2021 NSCH data links 4 or more hours of daily screen time among U.S. children and adolescents to worse mental-health and behavioral outcomes, with sleep and physical activity acting as mediators.

label: Judge Alsup's order separates AI training fair use from pirate-library exposure
description: Primary court order holds Anthropic's training on lawfully acquired books to be fair use while refusing to excuse the creation and retention of a permanent pirate-sourced central library.

label: A peer-reviewed study maps outsourced annotation labor in AI production chains
description: Big Data & Society publishes research showing that AI production relies on outsourced data workers in Madagascar and lengthens externalization chains rather than simply eliminating work through automation.

label: Congressional summary explains temporary domestic R&D expensing relief
description: CRS summary for H.R. 7024 states that domestic research costs could be expensed through 2025 and that the five-year deduction start date would be delayed until 2026.

label: H.R. 7024 text explicitly covers domestic R&D deductions and software
description: Congressional bill text records the proposed restoration of deductions for domestic research expenditures and states that software-development spending is treated as research or experimental expenditure.

label: Amazon and Salesforce tie layoffs to overhiring and cost structure
description: AP reports that both companies cut jobs after pandemic-era expansion, with executives explicitly citing stronger cost structure, economic downturn, and overhiring.

label: Financial Times says AI exuberance masks broader tech weakness
description: FT reports that large parts of the tech sector are still unwinding pandemic overhiring and weak demand even as AI attracts renewed capital and attention.

label: Reuters publishes a Q*-linked reporting trail tied to the OpenAI board crisis
description: Public citation metadata identifies a Reuters report saying researchers warned OpenAI's board about an AI breakthrough ahead of Altman's ouster, making the Q* thread part of the serious contemporaneous reporting record even though causality remained contested.

label: Reuters reports on OpenAI's Strawberry reasoning project before o1 release
description: Public citation metadata identifies a Reuters report on an OpenAI reasoning effort under the codename Strawberry, documenting a pre-release public trail for the reasoning-model line later associated with o1.

label: OpenAI launches o1-preview as a reasoning-focused model line
description: OpenAI publicly frames a new product tier around reinforcement learning, deliberate reasoning, and benchmark gains over GPT-4o in math, coding, and science tasks.

label: Financial Times reports OpenAI acknowledging higher bioweapon misuse risk for o1
description: Mainstream reporting documents that OpenAI's stronger reasoning-model release was accompanied by explicit public acknowledgement of higher misuse risk in biological domains.

label: OpenAI updates the o1 system card with preparedness and training-data details
description: OpenAI documents large-scale reinforcement learning for reasoning, a mixed public and proprietary training-data base, and deployment gates tied to post-mitigation risk scores.

label: Anthropic launches Claude 4 with extended-thinking commercial availability
description: Anthropic launches Claude Opus 4 and Claude Sonnet 4 as hybrid models capable of near-instant responses and extended thinking, while immediately distributing them through paid plans, API access, and major cloud platforms with differentiated pricing.

label: DeepSeek publishes its R1 reasoning paper and open release claims
description: DeepSeek presents R1-Zero and R1 as reinforcement-learning-based reasoning models, claims comparison with OpenAI-o1-1217 on reasoning tasks, and announces open releases and distilled variants.

label: OpenAI adds Adebayo Ogunlesi to its board during restructuring
description: FT reports that OpenAI appointed infrastructure and finance executive Adebayo Ogunlesi to its board as the company pursued restructuring and capital-intensive expansion.

label: Amazon and Anthropic tie frontier-model development to AWS cloud and chips
description: Amazon announces Anthropic will use AWS as its primary cloud provider, run the majority of its workloads on AWS, and use Trainium and Inferentia chips for future model training and deployment while Amazon invests up to $4 billion.

label: Axios reports record lobbying quarters for Anthropic and OpenAI
description: Axios reports, based on federal lobbying disclosures and Senate data, that Anthropic and OpenAI posted their biggest lobbying quarters to date while pressing issues tied to export controls, procurement, cloud infrastructure, copyright, and national security.

label: An OpenAI-linked PAC network pushes a national AI framework through midterm politics
description: Axios reports that Leading the Future and Build American AI, tied to OpenAI interests and Andreessen Horowitz, were spending in the 2026 midterms to back allies for a national AI framework and push against state-by-state governance.

label: BIS reaffirms license requirements for advanced computing items tied to D:5 and Macau entities
description: BIS issues guidance clarifying that advanced computing exports to entities headquartered in Country Group D:5 or Macau still require licenses, explicitly linking the regime to the November 2023 controls and the January 2025 AI Diffusion Rule.

label: Palantir, Anthropic, and AWS announce a classified-environment channel for Claude in U.S. defense and intelligence work
description: Palantir announces a partnership with Anthropic and AWS to provide U.S. intelligence and defense agencies access to Claude through Palantir AIP on AWS, including an IL6-accredited environment.

label: Anthropic launches Claude Gov for U.S. national security customers
description: Anthropic announces a custom set of Claude Gov models built exclusively for U.S. national security customers, already deployed in classified environments and tailored for intelligence, defense, and cybersecurity tasks.

label: The U.S. Army launches Detachment 201 and commissions senior tech executives into a reserve innovation corps
description: The Army creates Detachment 201 to embed senior commercial-tech leaders as part-time reserve advisors, naming executives from Palantir, Meta, and OpenAI in the initial cohort.

label: OpenAI launches OpenAI for Government and announces a DoD CDAO pilot
description: OpenAI formally consolidates its U.S. public-sector work under OpenAI for Government, offering secure access paths and limited national-security custom models while announcing a DoD CDAO pilot with a $200 million ceiling.

label: FEC data shows large-scale activity for Leading the Future in the 2025-2026 cycle
description: The FEC committee overview page for Leading the Future records an active Super PAC registered on August 15, 2025 and reports more than $75.5 million in receipts and more than $24.3 million in disbursements through March 31, 2026.

label: OpenAI launches the Superalignment initiative
description: OpenAI publicly commits compute, leadership, and governance rhetoric to the problem of controlling superintelligent systems under Ilya Sutskever and Jan Leike.

label: Mira Murati and other research leaders leave OpenAI
description: AP reports that Murati, Bob McGrew, and Barret Zoph depart, broadening the post-crisis leadership exodus beyond the earlier founder-level exits.

label: Anthropic revises its Responsible Scaling Policy around collective-action logic
description: Anthropic's RSP v3.0 frames frontier safety governance in competitor-contingent and policy-advocacy terms, documenting how safety rhetoric also functions as strategic legitimacy infrastructure.

label: OpenAI says Musk agreed the company would need a for-profit structure
description: AP reports OpenAI's formal rebuttal to Musk's nonprofit-mission claims, documenting that the institutional fight over structure and control was active and contested.

label: Musk files a federal complaint against Altman and OpenAI entities
description: CourtListener's docket records a federal complaint with jury demand against Altman, Brockman, OpenAI, Inc., OpenAI, L.L.C., OpenAI, L.P., and related entities, formalizing the governance dispute as continuing litigation.

label: Meta cuts Quest prices amid weak VR demand and heavy Reality Labs losses
description: Investopedia reports price cuts, plunging VR shipments, major Reality Labs losses, and investor pressure to reduce metaverse spending.

label: Market pressure intensifies around continued Reality Labs losses
description: MarketWatch reports that investor concern over Reality Labs overspending remained active even after Meta's broader rebound, reinforcing the financial fragility of the metaverse narrative.

label: A study documents mainstream acceptance as a driver of new OnlyFans sexual-content creators
description: A qualitative study of U.S.-based creators with no prior sex-work background finds that mainstream visibility, platform affordances, and pandemic disruption all helped normalize entry into monetized sexual content creation.

label: Researchers report rapid amplification of misogynistic recommendations on TikTok
description: Guardian coverage of UCL and Kent research says TikTok recommendations showed a four-fold increase in misogynistic content over a short monitoring period, supporting claims about algorithmic norm escalation.

label: A large-scale study documents system-level polarization dynamics across Reddit communities
description: Waller and Anderson analyze 5.1 billion Reddit comments across 10,000 communities and report that Reddit underwent a significant polarization event around the 2016 U.S. presidential election that remained elevated for years.

label: Axios reports a sharp pre-pandemic versus pandemic jump in children's screen time
description: Survey-based reporting indicates that household expectations around children's screen time changed significantly during the pandemic, providing a direct comparison between pre-pandemic and mid-2020 routines.

label: A pandemic-era earnings cycle highlights the divergence between big tech gains and small-business strain
description: TIME reports extraordinary earnings for major technology firms alongside Federal Reserve evidence of widespread small-business closures and distress, illustrating the asymmetry of pandemic-era digital concentration.

label: OpenAI documents a Reddit-filtered corpus for GPT-2 training
description: The GPT-2 paper describes WebText as a corpus built from outbound Reddit links with at least 3 karma, creating a direct documented bridge between social-platform attention signals and model-training inputs.

label: A federal court lets core New York Times copyright claims against OpenAI and Microsoft proceed
description: Judge Sidney H. Stein's opinion on motions to dismiss keeps core copyright theories alive and treats training-stage collection, storage, scraping, and dataset construction as central features of the dispute.

label: OpenAI and OpenResearch authors publish GPTs are GPTs on occupational exposure to LLMs
description: Early analytical anchor for arguing that generative-AI exposure reaches deep into professional and white-collar task structures.

label: The U.S. Department of Education releases its AI teaching-and-learning recommendations
description: Institutional anchor for treating cognitive literacy, educator oversight, and delegated judgment as governance issues.

label: The IMF publishes Gen-AI: Artificial Intelligence and the Future of Work
description: Institutional milestone for documenting uneven labor exposure and distributional risk under generative AI.

label: The FTC opens an inquiry into major AI investments and partnerships
description: Competition-policy turning point showing official scrutiny of startup-hyperscaler dependencies in frontier AI.

label: Researchers publish Computing Power and the Governance of Artificial Intelligence on arXiv
description: Research milestone for treating compute concentration as a material chokepoint in AI capability and access.

label: The role of workers in AI ethics and governance is posted to arXiv
description: Analytical milestone for treating labor voice and worker reporting as part of AI governance.

label: Researchers publish a paper on AI and digital public infrastructure
description: Research milestone for integrating public-value infrastructure, interoperability, and AI governance in the response agenda.

label: Pew publishes cross-national findings on social media, democracy, manipulation, and division
description: The report gives Chapter 2 a stronger bridge from social-platform effects to civic trust, democratic legitimacy, and perceived social division.

label: Dario Amodei publicly warns of AI-driven wealth concentration and describes Anthropic's 80% wealth pledge
description: A primary founder essay ties frontier-AI progress to backlash, democratic strain, and extreme concentration risk while presenting philanthropy as one partial response.

label: The Bipartisan House AI Task Force report cites Mark Uriostegui's weights-and-copyright argument
description: The official U.S. House report records the AI-training dispute in terms overlapping with the dossier's enclosure framework and cites Uriostegui's essay in footnote 40 on physical page 116, marking institutional uptake rather than proof by authority.

label: Pandemic-era dependence gives dominant tech firms a temporary reprieve from the pre-COVID techlash
description: Supporting event for treating COVID as not only a health shock but also a concentration and legitimacy shock that changed the policy atmosphere around large platforms.

label: Reddit announces a $60 million agreement allowing Google to train AI models on Reddit posts
description: Late-stage commercial licensing milestone that extends the social-data-to-models bridge from early web corpora into the frontier-AI platform economy.

label: Northwestern legal scholarship characterizes In-Q-Tel as a CIA-sponsored venture-capital structure
description: Useful milestone for documenting that the In-Q-Tel model was legible as a formal venture-state bridge and governance controversy well before the current AI boom.

label: Wired archives In-Q-Tel's dual public framing as CIA-linked and privately boarded under government contract
description: Important boundedness milestone because a contemporaneous archival feature described In-Q-Tel as CIA-linked while also quoting its communications leadership framing it as a private company with its own board and a government contract.

label: The Washington Post summarizes Palantir's CIA-incubator origin, Thiel connection, and government-enforcement role
description: Secondary-reporting milestone that ties Palantir's early seed funding, Peter Thiel's continuing role, and the company's later integration into U.S. government and ICE operations into one bounded institutional profile.

label: Judge denies Musk's immediate bid to block OpenAI's conversion path and offers an expedited trial track
description: Combined AP and FT procedural milestone showing that Musk's governance challenge remained live but did not secure immediate judicial relief stopping OpenAI's restructuring direction, while the court signaled public-interest stakes and willingness to move the case quickly.

label: Researchers publish a compute-optimal test-time scaling paper for LLMs
description: Research milestone showing that inference-time compute allocation could be treated as a serious performance and efficiency lever before frontier reasoning products became a mainstream commercial category.

label: Researchers release s1 as an open attempt to replicate test-time scaling
description: A visible open-research milestone showing that OpenAI's reasoning launch quickly triggered replication efforts built around budget forcing and small reasoning datasets.

label: A follow-up paper challenges simplistic readings of simple test-time scaling
description: Boundary-setting research milestone arguing that budget-forcing replications can mimic the appearance of scaling without reproducing the same mechanism as o1-like or R1-like systems.

label: Researchers publish SpecReason on latency overhead and acceleration for large reasoning models
description: Systems milestone showing that long chains of thought create real inference latency overhead and motivate specialized acceleration techniques for large reasoning-model serving.

label: The New Yorker profile records Sam Altman's survival-prep measures and New Zealand fallback plan with Peter Thiel
description: A major-profile milestone that put survivalist preparation, private fallback architecture, and a Thiel-linked New Zealand escape plan on the public record for a future central AI governance actor.

label: WIRED documents bunker-like features, secrecy controls, and self-sufficiency planning at Zuckerberg's Kauai compound
description: Investigation milestone showing that one of the central platform-era power holders was building a tightly secured estate with underground shelter and private redundancy features that later became relevant to the dossier's unequal-fallback argument.
